payload.summary: The official responsible for enforcing the rules faces the person or institution powerful enough to operate around them.
payload.body: The official responsible for enforcing the rules faces the person or institution powerful enough to operate around them. Saturn opposite Pluto can expose the difference between formal authority and actual leverage, especially when money, access, or private consequences make enforcement risky. A rule that only applies to people without power is not much of a rule. Put the exemption on the record. The confrontation matters if it produces a limit that applies to the office or institution, not only to the person easiest to punish.
